claims.claim: Duplicates can change IDF and scores of unchanged documents.
claims.forbidden_upgrade: New IR mechanism, first discovery, or unexpected mathematical principle.

claims.claim: In this pinned Mem0 raw/Qdrant-local pilot, ordinary post-commit redelivery admits extra physical records; all 24 queries have some original-record BM25/final changes while compared semantic/entity components stay fixed.
claims.forbidden_upgrade: All records changed, semantic corruption, or production incidence.

claims.claim: At nonbinding full retrieval depth, later source-event dedup still yields different sets in 10/24 questions and different orders in 17/24 under the study packing rule.
claims.forbidden_upgrade: 10/24 QA failures, missing relevant facts, universal inadequacy of all read-time dedup or 24 independent domains.

claims.claim: Keeping duplicate points searchable while restricting native IDF statistics to known clean physical IDs restores all compared original BM25/final components within 1e-12 and all 24 clean event orders/sets.
claims.forbidden_upgrade: Deployable oracle-free remedy, new IDF algorithm, preregistered held-out confirmation, or new task samples.

claims.claim: Dense-only LlamaIndex read-event dedup reportedly restores 24/24 retained pilot contexts.
basis: Parent-reported retained pilot comparison; not independently recomputed in this literature audit.
claims.forbidden_upgrade: Dense retrieval is always retry-invariant, dense is superior, or this cross-engine comparison alone isolates IDF.

claims.claim: This native Mem0 path uses fixed query-length sigmoid BM25 normalization and additive semantic/BM25/entity scoring, with a semantic gate.
claims.forbidden_upgrade: RRF, min/max-normalized fusion, or a guarantee shared by every Mem0 release/configuration.

claims.claim: The changed contexts harm or help answer correctness, safety, user outcomes, tokens or latency.
basis: No reader grades or performance outcomes inspected.
claims.forbidden_upgrade: Infer value/harm from context-set difference or literal diversity alone.

claims.claim: No prior work has connected duplicate ingestion, retrieval or RAG quality; this is publication-ready by novelty/count alone.
basis: Direct classical IDF antecedent plus close RAG studies; targeted search is not exhaustive.

claims.claim: Preventing repeated delivery admission requires an operation/event identity contract with explicit retention/lifetime semantics; exact-content filtering conflates legitimate same-content events.
basis: Existing RFC9110, agentmemory, PLUR and durable-execution literature audit.
claims.forbidden_upgrade: New idempotency protocol or treat all same-text observations as one event.

conditional_math.source: Qdrant local _compute_idf; algebraic rearrangement, not a new theorem.
conditional_math.duplicate_increment: I(N+m,d+a)-I(N,d)=ln((N+m+1)/(N+1))-ln((d+a+0.5)/(d+0.5)), where m extra physical sparse-vector documents are admitted and a of them contain the query term (0<=a<=m).
conditional_math.implication: Different term frequencies can change relative lexical contributions without changing original vectors. Score/rank changes are conditional; duplication need not change a given order, and either QA direction or no effect is possible.
conditional_math.composition: Collapsing source-event copies after native scoring changes the returned multiset but does not retroactively recompute the IDF statistics used to rank originals. This noncommutation is established reasoning, not a new recovery algorithm.

remaining_limits: Same 24 pilot questions in 14 scopes; post-hoc diagnostics and counterfactuals reuse them.
Known clean physical IDs are an oracle for the counterfactual.
Physical duplicate IDs are distinguished from legitimate fresh observations with identical bytes.
Ranking and context changes alone do not measure evidence usefulness, reader outcomes or independent corroboration.
Full-pool evidence must be checked against actual stored/candidate counts by the independent raw auditor.
